description: Check that an x402 endpoint still returns a valid payment challenge, and read its price and recipient. Probe an x402 endpoint and report whether it still returns a valid payment challenge: HTTP status, challenge source (v2 header or legacy body), scheme, network, asset, payTo, amount in atomic units and in USDC, and a list of concrete problems such as a decimal amount or a missing payTo. Query: ?url=&method= — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "check this payment endpoint", "inspect this x402 endpoint", "what does this endpoint charge".
name: x402_inspect
